summary: Iter 356 dark-mode + sidebar accordion verification (web only). All 7 requested features PASS. Sidebar is a controlled single-open accordion: fresh load shows 0 expanded groups (all 7 collapsed including 'Today'), clicking a header expands only that group, clicking a different group collapses the previous (exactly one open), clicking the open group again collapses it, and reload resets to 0 expanded (not persisted). Classification Self-Check dark: csc-step-head text 'Step 1 of 3...' renders in rgb(255,255,255) (bright/legible, NOT dark teal); csc-quiz border is rgba(165,81,43,0.55) clay-tinted; intro paragraph uses max-w-5xl class. Contribution Estimator dark: ce-stepper active step titles white rgb(255,255,255), done/upcoming titles light warm off-white rgb(199,194,184) — NOT teal, all legible. Landing dark (public /): ecosystem persona cards all dark and readable — Participants bg rgb(14,48,51), Caregivers bg rgb(46,27,18), Family bg rgb(22,36,26), all titles + body white; FAQ heading = 'Everything We Get Asked, Openly.', CTA heading = 'Ready When You Are' (both Title Case); Solo tier first bullet = 'For 1 person — one Participant, one Caregiver seat', Family tier first bullet = 'For 2 people — two full Participants included'. Footer dark: all 15 sampled links render rgba(255,255,255,0.9) (white). Light-mode regression clean: html has no theme-dark class on Budget Calculator, CSC, Landing, /app — sidebar unchanged (7 groups, 0 expanded).

issues: Minor: FieldRow <label> elements do NOT carry the tailwind 'first-letter:uppercase' class as described in the request. Computed style getComputedStyle(label,'::first-letter').textTransform returns 'none' for all sampled labels ('Person's name (optional)', 'Which best describes your situation?...', 'Do you have a Support at Home classification?', 'Your classification...'). Visually acceptable because the underlying label copy is already written with a capitalised first letter, so the rendered output looks identical to what the CSS rule would produce. Flagging as a spec vs implementation gap only — no user-visible defect.

action_items: OPTIONAL / low priority: If you specifically want tailwind's first-letter:uppercase CSS rule applied to Contribution Estimator FieldRow labels (as mentioned in the request), add the 'first-letter:uppercase' class to the label in the FieldRow component. Currently the underlying copy is already capitalised so this has no visual impact — visually the requirement is satisfied but the CSS spec is not.

Dark-mode CSS classes (dm-clay-selected, dm-input-light, dm-supplements-section) are all applied and produce the intended computed background/color combinations. No black-on-black or teal-on-teal contrast issues detected on the requested surfaces.

Landing persona cards now correctly branch on isDark: computed backgrounds are dark and titles/body copy are white rgba — resolves the previous white-on-light invisibility issue described in the request.
Footer dark override 'html.theme-dark footer a' works — all sampled links render rgba(255,255,255,0.9) (was teal previously).
Light-mode regression clean: <html> has NO theme-dark class after localStorage flip, and all four spot-checked routes render normally.
